label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off. E1 is indirect, class 6 evidence: the database records a past accident inside the area, but its location and reliability are unverified. Under the national criteria, an area with such a record is a clearance target after the first visit and cannot be released by non-technical survey alone; technical survey is unavailable. E2 is weaker indirect evidence and does not alter that route.
flags: The database accident record has not been checked on the ground; retain that uncertainty in the sign-off record.
The recommendation is not a final decision; submit for authorized review and sign-off.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1.

E1.quote: The national mine action database records one or more past landmine accidents inside this area.
E1.note: The accident record is indirect because its location has not been checked on the ground and its reliability is unassessed.

E2.quote: A trader passing through the vereda said people should keep away from the area because of mines, but could not say who had seen anything, or where.
E2.note: This is a second-hand warning with no identifiable first-hand source or specific location, so it suggests possible EO but does not confirm it.
